captions.instagram:
Etsy, eBay, Shopify and Amazon sellers: your 1099-K is not your profit.

✔️ Federally, a 1099-K comes when payments pass $20,000 and 200 transactions. Some states use lower limits.
✔️ Under the limit, the income still counts. The IRS says all income is taxable, 1099-K or not.
✔️ The 1099-K shows gross amounts, before fees, shipping and other adjustments.

So track your platform and payment fees, shipping labels and supplies, and the cost of what you sold, then reconcile them to the 1099-K.

Our Online Seller Bookkeeping Sheet does all of that in one workbook.

sources.fact: Form 1099-K required when gross payments exceed $20,000 and there are more than 200 transactions (OBBB reinstated); all income taxable even without a 1099-K; gross amount doesn't include adjustments for fees, credits, refunds, shipping; read 2026-10-24 (page updated 03-Apr-2026)
Etsy issues a 1099-K at the federal threshold or a lower state threshold (e.g. AR $2,500, IL $1,000, NJ $1,000, DC/MD/MA/VT/VA $600); form shows gross sales; read 2026-10-24
